shots.composition_other: Starts as a full-frame node graph of app tiles joined by thin white lines, then becomes three floating isometric cubes in a loose triangle.
shots.focal_element: The bell tile, which becomes the front cube among three icon cubes (stack/version, bell, gear).
shots.transition_other: Opens tight on a bell tile and pulls back through a flat node graph of app icons (Slack, Gmail, Sheets, HubSpot and others); in the 1:00.000-1:00.500 frames the graph is replaced by the 3D cubes. The exact incoming cut from s008 is not visible on the sheet.
shots.what_happens: As the VO says Zapier added three features to keep critical workflows online (w176-w187), the camera pulls out of a dense flat node graph of app tiles. The graph then turns into three rotating isometric cubes (lavender stack/version icon, pale-green bell, orange gear), each floating over a stacked translucent shadow plate. The cubes swap positions as they rotate, previewing the three features that follow.
shots.build_rebuild: Make three CSS/Three.js cubes with one line icon on every face and a stack of 2-3 translucent rhombus shadow plates under each; tween their rotateX/Y and x/y positions so they orbit and trade places over about 3 s after a scale-down pull-out from a flat node-graph layer.

shots.focal_element: The 'My Zap' card with its Versions side panel and the 'Edit from this version' menu item.
shots.transition_other: The background changes to a flat mint colour and the lavender version cube stays on the left while the UI card slides in from the right edge (first frame shows the card partly off screen).
shots.typography: Clean UI sans (grotesque, possibly Zapier's product font; low-confidence guess), sentence case, regular tracking; bold card title and panel heading, medium-weight step labels, small light-grey meta lines.
shots.what_happens: Version rollback (w188-w210): a simplified Zap editor card with three steps and a Versions panel slides in next to a slowly bobbing isometric version cube. The cursor clicks the '...' under Version 1, opens a menu (Rename version / Edit from this version) and picks 'Edit from this version'. The step list then reorders to the older version (1. New Event, 2. Notify team, 3. Set status).
shots.build_rebuild: Put a flat recreated card (rounded corners, offset hard black drop shadow) at right-centre, slide it in from x=100% with an ease-out, animate an SVG cursor to the kebab button, pop in a two-item menu, highlight the second item, then cross-swap the first and third step rows with a quick vertical slide.

shots.focal_element: The 'Frequency' dropdown on the default 'All Zaps' rule in the Error notifications settings card.
shots.typography: Same UI sans as the previous card; bold section headings in sentence case, regular labels, small grey dropdown values; white text on an indigo 'Create new' button.
shots.what_happens: Error notifications (w211-w239): on a saturated orange background, the settings card builds in row by row on the left while the bell cube floats on the right. The cursor opens the 'All Zaps' frequency dropdown (Immediately / Hourly / Never), picks Hourly, moves over 'Create new', then drifts off toward the cube as the shot ends.
shots.build_rebuild: Mirror the s010 layout (card left, cube right), stagger the card's rows in with a 60-80 ms fade/slide-up each, then script the cursor to open a select, highlight 'Hourly', commit it and hover the primary button.

shots.focal_element: The 'Auto replay override' dropdown and the 'Keep on for errors' radio in the Advanced Settings card.
shots.transition_other: The background swaps from orange to light peach; the gear cube appears on the left and the settings card on the right fills in after the cursor clicks the gear icon in the card's sidebar.
shots.typography: Same UI sans; bold panel heading, medium-weight field labels, regular dropdown and radio text in sentence case; the selected option has an indigo tint.
shots.what_happens: Advanced settings (w240-w258): the cursor clicks the gear in the card's icon sidebar and the Advanced Settings panel fills in. It opens 'Auto replay override', picks 'Always replay', then switches 'Keep Zap running' to 'Keep on for errors'. In the last frame (1:27.000) the whole frame shrinks into a rounded tile on a green field, starting the transition into s013.
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the card template with a narrow left icon rail; on a gear click, fade the panel body in, open a three-option select, commit 'Always replay', toggle a radio, then scale the whole composition down into a rounded-corner tile to hand off to the next shot.

shots.focal_element: The centre orange tile (gear cube + Advanced Settings card) with two pulsing orange warning badges on its corners.
shots.typography: The grid tiles hold miniature UI cards; their text is too small to read on the sheets or keyframe.
shots.what_happens: VO 'even if a zap breaks, you have the tools to troubleshoot with confidence' (w259-w272). The camera pulls back from a close-up to a 3x3 grid of pastel tiles on a rounded green board over deep indigo. Each tile holds a miniature UI card, including the version and error-notification cards from earlier. Two orange warning-triangle badges sit on the grid seams and give off soft radial glow rings. The board keeps shrinking and its corners round into a pill shape.
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out a 3x3 CSS grid of rounded pastel tiles with mini card screenshots inside a rounded green container, place two circular warning badges with repeating radial ring pulses (scale 1 to 1.6, opacity 0.5 to 0), and tween the container's scale down and border-radius up over about 3 s.
